children: Dalrada Technology Group, through subsidiary Genefic, has terminated two unfunded financing arrangements with IBS affiliates: a $20 million standby letter of credit and guaranty facility and a $5 million credit and receivables facility. IBS set Sep 15, 2026 as the effective termination date and issued default notices while assessing early termination fees of $200,000 and $100,000, respectively. Dalrada says no funding was ever provided under either facility and disputes the asserted fees and defaults, while reserving all rights and defenses. The company cautions that if IBS pursues remedies, such actions could impact liquidity and operations.
